steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Boolean laws: Identity, Null, Idempotent, Complement, Commutative, Associative, Distributive, De Morgan, Absorption

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: K-maps: 2-4 variables, groups of 1s (SOP) or 0s (POS); don't cares

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Circuits: Half adder (XOR+AND), Full adder (2 half + OR), MUX (select), Decoder (binary->one-hot)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Flip-flops: SR (set/reset), D (data), JK (toggle); Registers: shift, storage; Counters: async/sync

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Normalise to 3NF: Student(StudentID, Name, CourseID, CourseName, TutorID, TutorName) --- Solution: FDs: StudentID->Name, CourseID->CourseName, TutorID, TutorID->TutorName. 1NF: atomic. 2NF: remove partial FD (CourseID->CourseName). Course(CourseID, CourseName, TutorID), Tutor(TutorID, TutorName), Student(StudentID, Name, CourseID). 3NF: remove transitive FD (TutorID->TutorName). Already in 3NF
